subject.title: fix(messaging): document group recall and await Signal cleanup

question: Should this PR merge only after a maintainer accepts redacted after-fix Signal abandonment evidence for both handoff and exhausted-retry cleanup?
rationale: The intended ordering affects durable inbound-message ownership and cannot be established from CI status or comments alone; the protected maintainer label requires an explicit human merge judgment.

options.title: Require redacted Signal proof
options.body: Request a terminal capture, logs, recording, or linked live artifact showing cleanup settlement before replacement ownership or retry proceeds, with private values redacted.

options.title: Accept CI-only evidence
options.body: Merge based on the implementation and automated checks while explicitly accepting that no real Signal lifecycle trace was supplied.

recommendation.title: Require redacted Signal proof
recommendation.body: Request a terminal capture, logs, recording, or linked live artifact showing cleanup settlement before replacement ownership or retry proceeds, with private values redacted.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the related merged lifecycle work and the current Signal follow-up.
